content.text:
playwright-cli - run playwright mcp commands from terminal

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position
  mousedown [button]          press mouse down
  mouseup [button]            press mouse up
  mousewheel <dx> <dy>        scroll mouse wheel

Save as:
  screenshot [target]         screenshot of the current page or element
  pdf                         save page as pdf

Tabs:
  tab-list                    list all tabs
  tab-new [url]               create a new tab
  tab-close [index]           close a browser tab
  tab-select <index>          select a browser tab

Storage:
  state-load <filename>       loads browser storage (authentication) state from a file
  state-save [filename]       saves the current storage (authentication) state to a file
  cookie-list                 list all cookies (optionally filtered by domain/path)

import re, urllib.request, os
css=open('/tmp/fonts.css').read()
blocks=re.findall(r"@font-face\s*\{(.*?)\}", css, re.S)
seen=set()
for b in blocks:
    if 'U+0000-00FF' not in b: continue
    fam=re.search(r"font-family: '([^']+)'",b).group(1)
    weight=re.search(r"font-weight: (\d+)",b).group(1)

    name=f"{fam.replace(' ','')}-{weight}.woff2"
    if name in seen: continue
    seen.add(name)
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, f"public/fonts/{name}")

PY

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a polished 3D browser battle royale game in the existing PlayGround repo, styled after PUBG, with a base-building mechanic (walls/floors/ramps from harvested wood) plus enterable map buildings.
- The game must be playable, visually impressive, responsive/mobile-friendly, verified in a real browser, and committed as the project result.

## Requirements
- User prompt (verbatim): "3D battle royale PUBG-style with building"
- Desktop FPS controls and mobile touch controls; responsive layouts and safe-area handling.
- Must run in the OMGithub/Vite workflow: `index.html` at root, `npm run build`, server on port 3002.
- Verify with `playwright-cli` headed Chromium under Xvfb/SwiftShader; inspect actual screenshot; report software rendering honestly.
- Auto-capture clicks a visible button labeled exactly `Start`, `Play`, `Start Game`, `Start Now`, `Play Game`, or `Play Now`, so the primary start button text is `Start Game`.
- Do not break OMGithub README markers.

## Decisions
- Game name: **LAST CIRCLE** — 30-player solo battle royale.
- Stack: Vite 8 + Three.js 0.187, plain JS modules, procedural textures/audio (no external game assets).
- Self-hosted fonts downloaded to `public/fonts/` (Barlow Condensed 500–800, Rajdhani 400–700).
- Gameplay scope: 1 player + 29 AI bots, shrinking blue zone, 5 weapons (P92, UMP45, M416, S686, KAR98K), loot/armor/medkits, killfeed, minimap, compass, harvesting wood, snap building system, win/death/pause screens.
- Map: 760×760 procedural island with 7 named sites (Crossroads, Riverside, Hallow Farm, Old Town, Quarry, Airfield, Firebase), lakes, roads/runway, instanced trees/rocks/grass.
- Start immediately on the ground at `playerSpawn {x:8,z:31,yaw:0}` with starter M416/medkit/armor loot nearby; menu uses a cinematic orbit camera behind the overlay.
- Building: grid-snapped wall/floor/ramp (10 wood each), ghost preview green/red, destructible structures with HP, ramp approximated by 6 invisible step platforms.
- Quality settings persisted in localStorage; high quality enables bloom, shadows, grass; low disables them.
- `Redeploy` uses `location.reload()` with a sessionStorage auto-start flag (planned).
- Visual palette: tactical orange `#ff7a18`, dark charcoal, Barlow Condensed/Rajdhani typography.

## Work State
### Completed
- Project scaffolding: `package.json` (Vite/Three, scripts `dev`, `build`, `test`), `index.html` (menu, HUD, touch UI, pause, end screens), `src/style.css` (full responsive tactical UI).
- Downloaded self-hosted font files to `public/fonts/`.
- `src/config.js`: MATCH, WEAPONS, ZONE_PHASES, BUILD constants, BOT_NAMES, SITES, LAKES (updated depths 26/22), rarity.
- `src/utils.js`: math/noise/grid sampling/ray-AABB/ray-sphere helpers.
- `src/textures.js`: procedural canvas textures (grass, asphalt, concrete, plaster, wood, metal, roof, sandbag, crate, grass blade, muzzle flash, bullet hole, loot labels, smoke).
- `src/builder.js`: batching builder, material set, wall opening generator, house/shop/cabin/warehouse/hangar/control tower/tower/silo/tent/container/sandbags/crates/barrel/vehicle/fence/dock/helipad/power pole; fixed side-wall construction and chimney bug.
- `src/sites.js`: hand-placed layouts, loot points, bot spawns for all 7 sites plus 8 roadside cabins.
- `src/world.js`: heightfield/terrain, sky shader with clouds/sun, water shader, lights/shadows, roads, instanced trees/rocks/grass with wind, scattered props, physics queries, raycasts, minimap canvas; reordered props before flush and fixed `addLootPoint` calls.
- `src/input.js`: desktop + touch controls, pointer lock, joystick/look zones, action consumption.
- `src/audio.js`: procedural WebAudio guns/reload/hits/pickups/footsteps/ambient/zone hum.
- `src/fx.js`: tracers, sparks/dust particles, decals, muzzle flashes/light, debris.
- `src/loot.js`: loot crates with beams/labels, nearest/interact API.
- `src/zone.js`: shrinking zone phases, animated shader wall, HUD data getters.
- `src/building.js`: ghost preview, placement validation, wall/floor/ramp structures, physics registration, destruction.
- `src/viewmodel.js`: procedural first-person weapons, hands/arms, ADS/bob/sway/recoil/reload animation, muzzle world position, viewmodel light.

### Active
- `src/player.js` not yet written (controller, shooting, inventory, interactions, healing, building input, camera, damage).
- `src/bots.js` not yet written (AI, models, hit detection, bot-vs-bot/player, simulated eliminations, loot drops).
- `src/hud.js` not yet written (compass, minimap, prompts, killfeed, damage numbers/indicators, end stats, build HUD).
- `src/main.js` not yet written (renderer/composer, menu camera, state machine, loot/zone/building wiring, start/pause/end logic, game loop).

### Blocked
- None, but several known bugs need fixing before running:
  - `src/building.js`: remove nonsense line `if (this.world.distance2D ? false : false)`, call `updateDamage(dt)` from `update(dt)`.
  - `src/input.js`: add `this.pressed.add('fire')` on left mouse down (and touch fire down) for semi-auto edge detection.
  - `src/world.js`: `scatterProps()` now runs before flush (fixed), but verify scattered crate/prop calls and no null builder.
  - `src/world.js`: local `mergeGeometriesCompat` should be validated or replaced with `mergeGeometries` import.
  - `src/loot.js`: `take()` does not dispose sprite material; minor.
  - `src/sites.js`: remove illogical Crossroads dock (`b.dock(28,34,...)`) and possibly helipad for natural composition; verify no syntax errors.
  - `src/builder.js`: `wallRotated` center uses `this.local(ctx, lx, 0)` correctly; verify all side walls use it.
  - `src/player.js`/`main.js` need `scene.add(camera)` so viewmodel renders.
  - Lake/terrain and site flatness need visual verification after first run.

## Next Move
1. Fix listed bugs (`building.js` validation/updateDamage, input fire edge, sites cleanup).
2. Implement `src/player.js` (movement/collision/water, camera, firing with falloff/headshots, reload, ADS, inventory, loot interaction, harvest, heal, build mode, damage/death, stats).
3. Implement `src/bots.js` with animated low-poly soldiers, AI targeting/cover/fire, shared hitboxes, deaths/ragdoll, loot drops, bot names, off-screen eliminations, zone damage.
4. Implement `src/hud.js` (all DOM/canvas updates, killfeed, compass, minimap, damage numbers/direction, prompts, toasts, end screen).
5. Implement `src/main.js` (renderer, camera/menu orbit, composer/bloom, game loop, state machine, start/pause/restart, lighting/fog, wiring all systems).
6. Add `tests/*.test.mjs` for pure config/utils/zone math; run `npm install`, `npm run build`, `npm test`.
7. Run server on port 3002 in tmux, use `playwright-cli` to open, click Start Game, screenshot desktop and mobile; inspect image, iterate visuals/performance.
8. Update README below OMGithub markers with game description/controls; commit all changes.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: complete DOM for menu/HUD/touch/pause/end; IDs referenced by upcoming HUD/main.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/style.css`: full UI styling; classes/IDs must match JS.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/config.js`: weapons, zone phases, sites, match constants.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js`: terrain/physics/raycast API (`getHeight`, `groundHeight`, `resolveCircle`, `raycast`, `lootPoints`, `botSpawns`, `mapCanvas`).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/builder.js`: structure generators used by sites; beware wall/collider semantics.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/sites.js`: site layouts/loot/bot spawns; contains cleanup items.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/building.js`: player build system API (`setActive`, `setPiece`, `update`, `place`, `damage`, `updateDamage`).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/viewmodel.js`: `Viewmodel` API (`show`, `update`, `kickWeapon`, `startReload`, `endReload`, `muzzleWorld`, `setVisible`).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/loot.js`: `LootSystem` API (`nearest`, `take`, `addWeapon`, `update`).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/zone.js`: `Zone` API (`reset`, `start`, `update`, `outside`, `damagePerSecond`, `countdown`, `phaseLabel`, `nextRadius`, `nextCenter`, `danger`).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/input.js`: `Input` API (`lock`, `unlock`, `consume`, `endFrame`, `moveX/moveZ`, `firing`, `aiming`, `sprint`, `crouch`).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/fx.js`: `FX` API (`tracer`, `impact`, `muzzle`, `playerFlash`, `debris`, `update`).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: `AudioEngine` API (`init`, `setEnabled`, `gun`, `hit`, `kill`, `hurt`, `pickup`, `build`, `destroy`, `chop`, `heal`, `footstep`, `zone`, `update`).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/utils.js`: deterministic noise/grid/ray helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/package.json`: scripts/dependencies.

## Important Context
- Default OMG runtime start: Vite project → `npm ci`/`npm install`, `vite build --base ./`, serve `dist` on `PORT` (use 3002). `capture.sh` auto-starts the labeled button.
- Playwright Linux config: headed Chromium + SwiftShader; `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002`, `screenshot --filename=...`; expect CPU rendering, not GPU.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a polished 3D browser battle royale game in the existing PlayGround repo, styled after PUBG, with base-building via harvested wood and enterable buildings.
- Must be playable, visually impressive, responsive/mobile-friendly, verified in a real browser, and committed as the project result.

## Requirements
- User prompt (verbatim): "3D battle royale PUBG-style with building"
- Desktop FPS controls and mobile touch controls; responsive layout and safe-area handling.
- Must work in OMGithub/Vite workflow: root `index.html`, `npm run build`, server on port 3002.
- Verify with `playwright-cli` headed Chromium; inspect screenshot; report software rendering honestly.
- Auto-capture clicks a visible button whose label is exactly `Start`, `Play`, `Start Game`, `Start Now`, `Play Game`, or `Play Now`; primary button text is `Start Game`.
- Do not break OMGithub README markers.

## Decisions
- Game name **LAST CIRCLE**: 30-player solo BR, 1 player + 29 AI bots.
- Stack: Vite 8 + Three.js 0.187, plain JS modules, procedural assets/audio, self-hosted fonts.
- Scope: shrinking blue zone, 5 weapons, loot/armor/medkits, killfeed, minimap, compass, wood harvesting, snapped wall/floor/ramp building, win/death/pause screens.
- Map: 760×760 island, 7 named sites, lakes, roads/runway, instanced trees/rocks/grass.
- Start on the ground at `playerSpawn {x:8,z:31,yaw:0}` with M416/medkit/armor loot nearby; menu uses cinematic orbit camera.
- Palette: tactical orange `#ff7a18`, dark charcoal, Barlow Condensed/Rajdhani.
- `Start Game` begins match; `Redeploy` restarts in place (no reload); `Briefing` returns to menu in place.
- Touch build button cycles wall→floor→ramp→exit; touch USE harvests when no loot is nearby.

## Work State
### Completed
- Project scaffolding, root `index.html`, full responsive tactical UI, fonts, config, utilities, procedural textures.
- `builder.js`, `sites.js`, `world.js`, `input.js`, `audio.js`, `fx.js`, `loot.js`, `zone.js`, `building.js`, `viewmodel.js`.
- `player.js`: movement/collision/water/jump/crouch, camera/ADS/recoil, shooting with falloff/headshots/building damage, reload, inventory, loot pickup, harvesting, healing, build input, damage/death, stats.
- `bots.js`: 29 animated low-poly bots, target acquisition/LOS, combat/strafing, bot-vs-bot/player/zone damage, hitboxes, health bars, kills/ragdolls, loot drops, simulated eliminations.
- `hud.js`: compass, minimap, vitals/weapon/build/zone HUD, prompts, killfeed, damage numbers/direction, hitmarkers, toast, end screen.
- `main.js`: renderer, bloom composer on high quality, camera/menu orbit, game state machine, settings, pause/resume/restart/menu, game loop, touch/desktop wiring, debug surface `window.__LAST_CIRCLE__`.
- Fixed prior bugs: fire edge input, building ghost positioning/rotation, `updateDamage`, bogus validation line, invalid Crossroads dock, site count copy, scattered crate calls.
- Added `LootSystem.reset()` and `Building.clear()` for in-place restarts.
- `npm install` and `npm run build` succeed; dist served at port 3002.

### Active
- Browser verification/debugging: first load shows menu, but rendering currently throws repeated `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'value')` in Three `refreshFogUniforms`, originating from custom `ShaderMaterial` objects that declare `fog: true` but lack the required fog uniforms/chunks (likely `world.js` water shader, possibly sky/zone shaders).
- Need capture menu screenshot and inspect visual quality after fixing render error.

### Blocked
- Rendering is broken by the fog-uniform error above; gameplay screenshots cannot be validated yet.
- No tests yet; no README update/commit yet.

## Next Move
1. Fix custom `ShaderMaterial` fog incompatibility: either set `fog: false` on affected shaders (water, zone wall, inner shell, sky) or add full fog uniforms/chunks; inspect console for remaining errors.
2. Reload via `playwright-cli`, capture menu screenshot, then click `Start Game`, verify HUD/gameplay screenshot, movement/shooting/building, pause/end flow.
3. Test mobile landscape viewport/touch UI; inspect screenshots and fix layout/perf/visual defects.
4. Add `tests/*.test.mjs` for config/utils/zone/building invariants; run `npm test`.
5. Re-run `npm run build`; update README below OMGithub markers with game description/controls; commit all changes.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: renderer/composer/game loop/state/settings/debug; recently completed.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/player.js`: player controller/combat/inventory/build input.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/bots.js`: AI/models/damage/killfeed/loot.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/hud.js`: all HUD/canvas/modal updates.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js`: terrain/site generation/physics/raycast/minimap; likely fog shader culprit.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/zone.js`: custom zone shader; also check fog uniforms.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: DOM/IDs; initial HUD/pause/end now `hidden`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/style.css`: responsive HUD/menu/touch styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/building.js`: build ghosts/validation/physics/destruction.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/loot.js`: loot entities + reset.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/package.json`: Vite/Three scripts/deps.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: update only below OMGithub markers.

## Important Context
- Playwright console log after first load: `THREE.WebGLShadowMap: PCFSoftShadowMap has been removed. Using PCFShadowMap instead.` and repeated `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'value') at Object.refreshFogUniforms`.
- Server currently runs in background from `npm run dev` on `http://localhost:3002`.
- Playwright Chromium was just installed via `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`; session `default` is open at the game URL.
- Menu snapshot is present and populated; page title is `LAST CIRCLE — Battle Royale`; console reported 3 errors.
- `renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap` should be changed to `THREE.PCFShadowMap` to remove warning.
- Camera convention: yaw 0 faces `-Z`; forward `(-sin(yaw), 0, -cos(yaw))`; pitch decreases with positive mouse `movementY`; rotation order `YXZ`.
- `viewmodel` is child of camera; camera is added to scene.
- Bots initialized via `bots.reset()` before menu so they are not clustered at origin.
- All work is uncommitted in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`; git status shows untracked project files.
- Port 3002 is current test server; build output is `dist/`.

  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position
  mousedown [button]          press mouse down
  mouseup [button]            press mouse up
  mousewheel <dx> <dy>        scroll mouse wheel

Save as:
  screenshot [target]         screenshot of the current page or element
  pdf                         save page as pdf

Tabs:
  tab-list                    list all tabs
  tab-new [url]               create a new tab
  tab-close [index]           close a browser tab
  tab-select <index>          select a browser tab

Storage:
  state-load <filename>       loads browser storage (authentication) state from a file
  state-save [filename]       saves the current storage (authentication) state to a file
  cookie-list                 list all cookies (optionally filtered by domain/path)
  cookie-get <name>           get a specific cookie by name
  cookie-set <name> <value>   set a cookie with optional flags
  cookie-delete <name>        delete a specific cookie
  cookie-clear                clear all cookies
  localstorage-list           list all localstorage key-value pairs
  localstorage-get <key>      get a localstorage item by key
  localstorage-set <key> <value> set a localstorage item
  localstorage-delete <key>   delete a localstorage item
  localstorage-clear          clear all localstorage
  sessionstorage-list         list all sessionstorage key-value pairs
  sessionstorage-get <key>    get a sessionstorage item by key
  sessionstorage-set <key> <value> set a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-delete <key> delete a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-clear        clear all sessionstorage

Network:
  requests                    list all network requests since loading the page. each request is numbered for use with the `request` command.
  request <index>             show full details (headers, body, response) of a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-headers <index>     print only the request headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-body <index>        print only the request body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  response-headers <index>    print only the response headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  response-body <index>       print the response body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command. textual bodies are inlined; binary bodies are saved to a file and the path is printed.
  route <pattern>             mock network requests matching a url pattern
  route-list                  list all active network routes
  unroute [pattern]           remove routes matching a pattern (or all routes)
  network-state-set <state>   set the browser network state to online or offline

DevTools:
  console [min-level]         list console messages
  run-code [code]             run playwright code snippet
  recording-start             start recording user actions
  recording-stop              stop recording user actions and print them as playwright code
  tracing-start               start trace recording
  tracing-stop                stop trace recording
  video-start [filename]      start video recording
  video-stop                  stop video recording
  video-chapter <title>       add a chapter marker to the video recording
  video-show-actions          annotate subsequent cli/mcp actions on the page with a callout that names the action and highlights the target element
  video-hide-actions          stop annotating actions performed on the page
  show                        show playwright dashboard
  pause-at <location>         run the test up to a specific location and pause there
  resume                      resume the test execution
  step-over                   step over the next call in the test
  generate-locator <target>   generate a playwright locator for the given element
  highlight [target]          show (or with --hide, remove) a highlight overlay for an element; `--hide` without a target hides all page highlights.

Install:
  install                     initialize workspace
  install-browser [browser]   install browser

Browser sessions:
  list                        list browser sessions
  close-all                   close all browser sessions
  kill-all                    forcefully kill all browser sessions (for stale/zombie processes)

Global options:
  --help [command]            print help
  --json                      output response as JSON
  --raw                       output only the result value, without status and code
  --version                   print version

<!-- omgithub:readme:end -->

## LAST CIRCLE

A browser-native 3D battle royale built with Three.js and Vite. Drop onto a **4.2 km² island**, loot five weapons, harvest timber, raise cover, and outlast 29 AI hostiles as the blue zone closes.

### Play

```bash
npm install
npm run dev      # http://localhost:3002
npm run build    # production bundle in dist/
npm test         # gameplay + math invariants
```

Open the page, click **Start Game**, then click the world once to capture the mouse. On phones, rotate to landscape; touch sticks and action buttons appear automatically.

### Controls

| Action | Desktop | Touch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Move / sprint | `WASD` / `Shift` | left stick / push to edge |
| Look / aim / fire | mouse / `RMB` / `LMB` | right side / `ADS` / `FIRE` |
| Jump / crouch | `Space` / `Ctrl` | `JUMP` / `CROUCH` |
| Reload / interact / heal | `R` / `E` / `H` | `RELOAD` / `USE` / `HEAL` |
| Harvest wood | `F` (hold) | `USE` near a tree |
| Build mode | `Q`, then `1`-`3` pieces, `R` rotate | `BUILD` cycles wall → floor → ramp → exit |
| Place piece | `LMB` | `FIRE` |
| Pause / resume | `Esc` | pause button |

### Features

- 30-player solo match with 29 named bots, simulated rotations, bot-vs-bot fights, killfeed, and loot drops.
- Shrinking six-phase blue zone with damage-over-time and a live minimap/compass.
- Five weapons with recoil, spread, falloff, headshots, ADS, reloads, armor, and medkits.
- Harvestable trees and a snapped wall/floor/ramp builder with destructible cover and walkable ramps.
- Procedural 760×760 island with seven named sites, roads, runway, lakes, buildings, and instanced vegetation.
- Responsive tactical HUD, pointer-lock desktop controls, and touch layout with safe-area support.
- Procedural audio, tracers, impacts, hitmarkers, damage direction, end-of-match stats, and in-place redeploy.

All art, audio, and fonts are generated or self-hosted; no external runtime assets are required.

## Objective
- Build a polished 3D browser battle royale game in the existing PlayGround repo, styled after PUBG, with base-building via harvested wood and enterable buildings.
- Must be playable, visually impressive, responsive/mobile-friendly, verified in a real browser, and committed as the project result.

## Requirements
- User prompt (verbatim): "3D battle royale PUBG-style with building"
- Desktop FPS controls and mobile touch controls; responsive layout and safe-area handling.
- Must work in OMGithub/Vite workflow: root `index.html`, `npm run build`, server on port 3002.
- Verify with `playwright-cli` headed Chromium; inspect screenshots; report software rendering honestly.
- Auto-capture clicks a visible button whose label is exactly `Start`, `Play`, `Start Game`, `Start Now`, `Play Game`, or `Play Now`; primary button text is `Start Game`.
- Do not break OMGithub README markers.

## Decisions
- Game name **LAST CIRCLE**: 30-player solo BR, 1 player + 29 AI bots.
- Stack: Vite 8 + Three.js 0.187, plain JS modules, procedural assets/audio, self-hosted fonts.
- Scope: shrinking blue zone, 5 weapons, loot/armor/medkits, killfeed, minimap, compass, wood harvesting, snapped wall/floor/ramp building, win/death/pause screens.
- Map: 760×760 island, 7 named sites, lakes, roads/runway, instanced trees/rocks/grass.
- Start on the ground at `playerSpawn {x:8,z:31,yaw:0}` with P92 and M416/medkit/armor loot nearby; menu uses cinematic orbit camera.
- Palette: tactical orange `#ff7a18`, dark charcoal, Barlow Condensed/Rajdhani.
- `Start Game` begins match; `Redeploy` restarts in place (no reload); `Briefing` returns to menu in place.
- Touch build button cycles wall→floor→ramp→exit; touch USE harvests when no loot is nearby.
- Lighting tuned brighter (hemi 0.95, ambient 0.24, sun 2.55, exposure 1.06, bloom 0.36/0.7/0.9) to improve dark foreground visibility.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full project scaffolding, responsive tactical UI, fonts, config, utilities, procedural textures.
- `builder.js`, `sites.js`, `world.js`, `input.js`, `audio.js`, `fx.js`, `loot.js`, `zone.js`, `building.js`, `viewmodel.js`.
- `player.js`: movement/collision/water/jump/crouch, camera/ADS/recoil, shooting with falloff/headshots/building damage, reload, inventory, loot pickup, harvesting, healing, build input, damage/death, stats.
- `bots.js`: 29 animated low-poly bots, target acquisition/LOS, combat/strafing, bot-vs-bot/player/zone damage, hitboxes, health bars, kills/ragdolls, loot drops, simulated eliminations.
- `hud.js`: compass, minimap, vitals/weapon/build/zone HUD, prompts, killfeed, damage numbers/direction, hitmarkers, toast, end screen.
- `main.js`: renderer, bloom composer, camera/menu orbit, game state machine, settings, pause/resume/restart/menu, game loop, touch/desktop wiring, debug surface `window.__LAST_CIRCLE__`.
- Fixed fog-uniform crash by setting water ShaderMaterial `fog: false`; switched to `THREE.PCFShadowMap`.
- Fixed malformed builder colliders: `World.addObstacle` now accepts both flat bounds and `THREE.Box3` and rejects non-finite values, eliminating player `NaN` position/falling.
- Fixed Escape pause: changed two `if`s to `if/else if` so pause is not immediately resumed.
- Fixed build validation to collide with all tall static world obstacles, not only nonexistent `kind === 'static'`.
- Added and passed 27 tests in `tests/*.test.mjs` (config, utils, zone, building invariants).
- Verified menu, gameplay, M416 pickup/equip, shooting, kill + killfeed + loot drop, wall placement, harvesting, pause screen, death screen, win screen, Redeploy, mobile landscape touch controls, touch fire/build cycling, portrait rotate overlay.
- `npm install`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` succeed; production build tested at `http://localhost:3003` with no console errors.
- README updated below OMGithub markers with game description, controls, features, and commands.
- No commit yet; all work remains uncommitted.

### Active
- Final wrap-up: stage/commit all changes and ensure checkpoint is clean.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `git status` and review diff for unintended files (`dist/` is currently untracked).
2. Re-run `npm test && npm run build` after final README/code edits.
3. Commit all project files with a descriptive message (do not alter OMGithub README markers).
4. Optionally re-check final menu/gameplay screenshots and report software-rendering FPS honestly.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: renderer/composer/game loop/state/settings/debug; Escape and lighting edits.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js`: terrain/site generation/physics/raycast/minimap; fog, lighting, and collider fixes.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/building.js`: build ghosts/validation/physics/destruction; static-obstacle validation fix.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/player.js`: controller/combat/inventory/build input/harvesting.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/bots.js`: AI/models/damage/killfeed/loot.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/hud.js`: all HUD/canvas/modal updates.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/style.css`: responsive HUD/menu/touch styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: DOM/IDs/menu/HUD/touch controls.

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/dist/`: production build output.

## Important Context
- Dev server runs in background on `http://localhost:3002`; production test server on `http://localhost:3003`.
- `.gitignore` currently untracked and may or may not exclude `dist/`/`node_modules`; check before committing.
- Playwright sessions: `default` desktop, `mobile` touch/landscape, `prod` production build.
- Screenshots saved under `/tmp/opencode/shots/` (`menu.png`, `game3.png`, `loot.png`, `kill.png`, `pause.png`, `death.png`, `win.png`, `mobile-game.png`, `prod-game.png`, etc.).
- Software rendering reports ~23–24 FPS at high quality; game auto-reduces `renderScale` below 24 FPS.
- Console is clean except WebGL `ReadPixels` performance warnings caused by screenshots.
- Camera convention: yaw 0 faces `-Z`; `forward = (-sin(yaw), 0, -cos(yaw))`; positive pitch looks up; rotation order `YXZ`.
- Desktop build controls in build mode: `1` wall, `2` floor, `3` ramp, `R` rotate, `LMB` place; `Q` exits build mode.
- Bots initialize via `bots.reset()` before menu; `LootSystem.reset()` and `Building.clear()` support in-place restarts.
- Win/death/end screen stats derive from `player.kills`, `player.damageDealt`, and `elapsed`; synthetic `endGame(true)` shows 0 kills unless bots were actually eliminated.

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.
